glosses: avenue (broad street, especially bordered with trees)
a radial avenue (an avenue radiating from a central point, especially bordered with trees)
avenue (means by which something may be accomplished)

examples.text: Je l'ai rencontrée par hasard sur la 3e avenue.
examples.en: I met her by accident on Third Avenue.

examples.text: Mon bureau fait face à la Cinquième Avenue.
J'aimerais faire du shopping sur la Cinquième Avenue à New York.
examples.en: I'd like to do shopping on Fifth Avenue in New York.
